GitHubAgentCard component: GitHub badge, stars/forks display, topics as badges, 'View on GitHub' link
GitHub agent profile pages: Agent name, builder, GitHub stats (126,375 stars), repository link, GitHub badge
GitHub-specific stats display: Stars count replacing deployment count, forks count, language, license info
Skills derivation from GitHub topics: AI Agents, Anthropic, Charqpt, Deepagents with 98% benchmarks

Category filtering: Works with GitHub agents (Coding & Development filter)
Sort by stars: GitHub agents properly sorted by stargazer count
Tab switching: 'All Agents' vs 'GitHub Imported' tabs work correctly
Mixed agent display: GitHub agents displayed alongside regular agents
GitHub repository links: External links to GitHub repos working
Trust score calculation: GitHub agents show trust scores based on stars/community metrics
